title: Cybersecurity & DevSecOps
description: Techlio secures applications, cloud and AI systems: security assessments, identity and access hardening, automated checks in the pipeline, monitoring and response.
h1: Security built into the system, not bolted on before the audit.
intro: We assess, harden and monitor the applications, cloud accounts and AI features your business runs on. The engineers who find a weakness are the same ones who fix it in code.
caption: A code change passes secret scanning, code analysis, dependency and infrastructure checks, then a security review, before deployment and runtime monitoring.

card.lead: Pass the security review, and deserve to.
card.text: Security assessments, access hardening and automated checks in every release, covering your application, your cloud and the AI features on top.

offerIntro: Four stages, in order. Each one leaves you with evidence you can show a customer or an auditor.

offerings.title: Assess
offerings.text: Threat model, architecture and code review, and a cloud configuration review. Findings are ranked by real risk, with the fix described for each.

offerings.title: Harden
offerings.text: Role-based access, multi-factor authentication, secrets management, tenant isolation and least-privilege cloud permissions, implemented in your codebase.

offerings.title: Automate
offerings.text: Secret scanning, code analysis, dependency and infrastructure checks run on every change, so a vulnerability is stopped before it is merged.

offerings.title: Monitor and respond
offerings.text: Logging, alerting and incident runbooks in place, with a named owner for every alert and a tested path to roll back.

whyTitle: Why engineering teams bring us in

why.title: Engineers who fix, not just report
why.text: You get merged pull requests alongside the findings. A PDF of issues with no owner is where most security work stalls.

why.title: AI attack surface included
why.text: Prompt injection, data leakage through retrieval and over-permissioned tools are tested the same way as the rest of your application.

why.title: Evidence for your buyers
why.text: Access controls, test results and audit trails are documented as we go, which shortens the security questionnaires your sales team faces.

closeTitle: Facing a security review, or want one before a customer asks?
closeText: Tell us what you run and who is asking. You will get a first read on scope and priorities within 24 hours.
